# Projects & Research

Below are selected academic and industry projects I have completed at UCLA and during past internships.


## Stats 101B - Effects of Exercise on Memory  
Designed and analyzed a randomized complete block experiment on whether different durations of light jogging (5 vs 30 minutes) affect memory game performance. Methods included ANOVA, model checking, and power analysis.

[View PDF](projects/Stat101B.pdf)


## Stats 101C - Predicting NBA Game Outcomes  
Modeled NBA game outcomes using logistic regression, XGBoost, and Random Forest with continuous retraining through the season. Achieved ~74% accuracy on updated models.

[View PDF](projects/Stat101C.pdf)


## Comm 188C - AI Policy vs Public Opinion  
Compared AI legislation and Reddit discussion using sentiment analysis (VADER), topic modeling (BERTopic), and zero-shot classification into themes (Bias, Privacy, Transparency).

[View PDF](projects/Comm188C.pdf)


## Nike Internship - Commercial Analytics Deck  
Developed strategic analytics and a merchandising framework for Nike product teams during summer internship. This deck summarizes high-level insights and recommendations.

[View Slide Deck](projects/NikePres.pptx)
